title: The perfect divisibility and chromatic number of some odd hole-free graphs
summary: A hole is an induced cycle of length at least 4, and an odd hole is a hole of odd length. It is NP-hard to color the vertices of an odd hole-free graph. A graph $G$ is perfectly divisible if every induced subgraph $H$ of $G$ with at least one edge admits a partition of $V(H)$ into sets $A$ and $B$ such that $H[A]$ is perfect and $ω(H[B])<ω(H)$. $G$ is short-holed if every hole in $G$ has length 4.
